now.definition:
n. the momentary present
r. in the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events
r. used to preface a command or reproof or request
r. at the present moment
now.translation:
adv. 现在, 刚才, 目前
n. 现在
a. 现在的
conj. 由于

now or never.translation: 勿失良机; 机不可失; 时不再来; 只在此刻

now, now.translation: 用于表示不赞成[劝慰]的话语之前

now-or-never.translation: 勿失良机，机不可失；把握现在

nowackiite.translation: n. [矿](在瑞士发现的)硫化铜锌砷矿

nowaday.translation: a. 现在的, 当前的

nowadays.translation:
n. 现在, 现时, 当今
adv. 时下, 现今

nowak.translation: n. (Nowak)人名；(英、捷、瑞典、芬、法、德、波)诺瓦克

noway.translation: adv. 一点...也不, 决不...

noways.definition: adv. In no manner or degree; not at all; nowise.

nowed.definition: a. Knotted; tied in a knot, as a serpent.
nowed.translation: abbr. National Organization for Women (美国)全国妇女组织

nowel.definition:
n. Christmas; also, a shout of joy at Christmas for the birth
   of the Savior.
n. A kind of hymn, or canticle, of mediaeval origin, sung in
   honor of the Nativity of our Lord; a Christmas carol.
n. The core, or the inner part, of a mold for casting a large
   hollow object.
n. The bottom part of a mold or of a flask, in distinction from
   the cope; the drag.

nowell.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 诺埃尔 Noel的变体

nower.translation: abbr. National Organization for Women (美国)全国妇女组织

nowers.translation: (nower 的复数) abbr. National Organization for Women (美国)全国妇女组织

nowhence.translation: adv. <古>无论来自何处都不,什么地方都不到(或没有)

nowhere.definition:
n. an insignificant place
r. not anywhere; in or at or to no place
nowhere.translation: adv. 无处, 到处都无

nowheres.translation:
adv. 无处；任何地方都不；毫无结果
n. 无处；任何地方；无名之地
a. 不存在的；毫无结果的；不知名的

nowhither.definition: adv. Not anywhither; in no direction; nowhere.

nowness.definition: n. the quality of being the present

nowruz.translation: [网络] 纳吾肉孜节；伊朗新年；诺鲁孜节
